title: Rusted after 2 uses and being kept indoors
text: Rusted after 2 uses and being kept indoors. As the title says, this burner was used twice and kept in our garage when not in use and it has begun to rust. The rust seems deeper than surface rust. I opted to pay more for the stainless version so that it would last longer when i could have saved the money and bought the black steel version.
